sources.title: xflux_text_encoders | PromptLayer Models
sources.snippet: xflux_text_encoders is a specialized text encoding model that implements the encoder components from Google's T5 (Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer) architecture. Developed by XLabs-AI, this model focuses on converting text inputs into meaningful vector representations that can be used for various downstream natural language processing tasks.

sources.title: Real-time Cigarette Detection - General Model Introduction
sources.snippet: This model is the real-time cigarette detection model in the high-performance popular application series of detection models, based on the high-performance detection framework DAMOYOLO aimed at industrial deployment. Its accuracy and speed surpass those of the current classic YOLO series methods.
